explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/660: do the n vertices of a convex polyhedron in ℝ³ determine at least (1−o(1))n/2 distinct distances? IsPolyhedronVertices requires convex independence and full affine span, i.e. vertex sets of 3-dimensional convex polytopes. The statement says: for every ε > 0, for all large n, every such n-set has distinctDistances ≥ (1−ε)n/2, which is the standard unpacking of (1−o(1)). Faithful.
